notes.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?! Update! Lots of fixes to gamepad controls & more!
notes.notes:
Howdy howdy y'all! So as we're looking to future proof CSD 3 for the years to come something we've wanted to do for a while is redo a lot of the gamepad control code, specifically for co-op. There were moments when menus could overlap each other and such, and those problems were much more pronounced when using an xinput controller such as a PS4 pad. 

So we've gone in and replaced a lot of the code to better support two gamepads at a time on PC, and fixed the broken xinput gamepad support since our last patch (apologies for that!). Full details are below- and hey, if you haven't wishlisted our next game, Cook Serve Forever, perhaps you could check it out! It's coming very soon and wishlists GREATLY help us!! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928090/Cook_Serve_Forever/

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

[list]
[*]Overhauled gamepad support, specifically for two player co-op, to better prevent rare issues with menu overlaps and bugs when using xinput and non-xinput pads. 
[*]Fixed xinput gamepad support (such as PS4 gamepads) for single player and co-op.
[/list]
We plan on releasing a patch in the future that updates the links in the Socials menu as well as adding a "do not show again" toggle for the opening splash box. Thanks so much y'all for all of the support!!

notes.title: CSD 3 New Patch Released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We just released a new CSD 3 build for both PC and Mac, woo! Here's all the changes:

[b]UPDATE: If you are having issues with the Mac build after updating (it will not start and throws a Steam error code) please uninstall and then reinstall the game and that should fix it. 

If you update the Mac version, but do not see your save files in the game, they are not deleted! You'll need to copy them over to a new folder like so: 

-navigate to ~/Library/Application Support/com.yoyogames.macyoyorunner and copy the .ini files you see there (XS_CSD3_LocalSave.ini).
-if it's not there, try looking in ~/Library/Application Support/net.vertigogaming.csdthree
-copy these files to ~/Library/Application Support/net.vertigogaming.cookservedelicious3

We apologize for the issue![/b]

[b]All Versions[/b]

[list]
[*]Improved performance by rebuilding the game using the latest Game Maker 2.2 edition, which is why the patch download is so large. 
[*]Improved performance in the opening menu screen as well as the first tutorial with changes to the texture loading system.
[*]Replaced opening text splash with a new Cook Serve Forever splash.
[*]Fixed and improved some visual menu elements to better integrate gamepad and PC/mouse controls.
[/list]

[b]Mac Version[/b]

[list]
[*]The game now runs on a new build for Mac that properly integrates all Steam features into the game (up until now we had a separate beta branch to use if players wanted to use certain Steam features like Achievements). 
[/list]

[i]As always, you can roll back to the previous version in the Beta Branch should you need to (right click CSD 3 on Steam, properties, then beta branches and select v1.01)[/i]

In case you didn't know, Cook Serve Forever was announced recently! If you love cookin' and servin' then you're gonna love our all new take on this series. Check it out and wishlist/follow today, every wishlist and follow helps TREMENDOUSLY!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928090/Cook_Serve_Forever/

[b][url=https://t.co/S73SZMhUj8]Be sure to follow us on our social platforms for more game info![/url][/b]

I hope everyone is doing well in these difficult times, sending much love to everyone.

notes.title: Balance Update v0.99 Now Available!
notes.notes:
Here it is, the update before we launch v1.0 next week! I've been listening to feedback since the game was content complete this summer and made some adjustments to the balance of the game.

The biggest change is the significant increase in bad orders you can get to get a bronze medal- you can now get up to 14 bad orders, instead of 7. You can also get up to 7 bad orders for silver instead of 4. This is mainly to help progression in the early stages, and of course gold medals still require flawless runs.

I've also boosted the two weaker truck upgrades a bit, and nerfed a particularly deadly food truck attack, as well as adding some bug fixes and improvements. This update will go live for consoles either on launch day or shortly thereafter on October 14th on PS4/Xbox/Switch!

Thanks everyone for all the support, and we'll see you next week for the big 1.0 launch! (v1.0 will contain minor bug fixes). 


= PATCH v0.99 NOTES =

= BALANCE CHANGES =

-Silver Medals require <8 average/bad (instead of <5)
-Bronze Medals require <15 bad (instead of <8)
-The Max Wieners sniper attack that reduces freshness expiration by 80% has been decreased to 40%
-Special System Analyzer: Lv.1 increased to 7sec (from 5), Lv.2 increased to 14sec (from 10), Lv.3 to 21sec (from 15). 
-Heat Lamps: Lv.1 increased to 20% (from 15%), Lv.2 to 40% (from 30%), Lv.3 to 60% (from 45%).


= IMPROVEMENTS AND FIXES =

-Two new trinkets added.
-Improved performance for PC/consoles.
-Fixed issue with Discord Rich Presence food statuses.
-Final art added for all "outro" cutscenes.
-Overhauled a large portion of the audio to reduce the memory footprint.
-Redid a lot of texture groups to help reduce memory footprint.
-Fixed a few mislabeled items for foods.
-Fixed rare issue with controller not responding during the Tutorial phase.

notes.title: Drydock Harbor Update (v0.85) is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Given that this would be the last territory update before our final major territory, I wanted to go a bit nuts and make a very experimental area, Drydock Harbor! It's a very small territory, with no new food trucks and limited filters, but I wanted to see what people thought of the unique days. 

The last territory update next month will go back to more traditional levels and features, but I wanted one last try to go crazy.

Also in this update are 24 new trinkets! Not only that, I've overhauled the sprite cache code so that you can now enjoy much smoother performance in-game! You can toggle this new loading system on and off, see the notes below (default is the new loading system). And we also finished up the food descriptions and added more achievements! Whew!

Enjoy the surprise update and cya next month for the finale!!! And as always, thank you so much for all the great reviews!


= UPDATE v0.85 NOTES =
= NEW ADDITIONS =

* DRYDOCK HARBOR added with 23 new experimental levels! 
* 24 new trinkets added, including four unlockable story based trinkets!
* 5 new achievements added!
* A new loading system has been added to better improve performance in-game. This caches your current menu during the load times, so that the game doesn't "hitch" when loading up a new food, but may increase level load times by a few seconds depending on your computer's performance. If you'd like to go back to the old way of loading used in previous CSD 3 versions (and in CSD 2), go to the Options menu, then Gameplay, and toggle Fast Load to ON. 
* Added a more descriptive line from Cleaver with the Max Wieners food truck attack.
* The following descriptions have been added: 
	-Tonkatsu
	-Food Truck Fries
	-Food Truck Beans
	-Food Truck Rice
	-Haemul Pajeon
	-Sinigang
	-Bibingka
	-Green Papaya Salad
	-Huauzontles
	-Jambalaya


= BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS =

* Fixed an issue with turning off certain upgrades that affected gameplay.
* Fixed issue with the No More Burgers trinket unlocking without earning a gold medal in the required day.
* Fixed bug where the scroll bar was not responding properly with the mouse in the Customize Truck menu.
* Fixed a few food description texts and punctuation.

notes.title: Metro Central Update Preview!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/63b635878c8c309daa6f32f58e9704360d4595d0.png[/img]

Welcome y'all to another update of your favorite post-apocalyptic food truck simulator! 

Metro Central is a large city with nothing really extraordinary at all. The plain hum-drum life is a nice break from the chaos of the world, despite the dark clouds looming overhead. 

That's not to say it's an easy challenge, oh no. Not only are there difficult levels ahead, but this area introduces a new food truck that can unleash a super attack! Max Wieners is on the scene with a sniper rifle that targets your temperature regulator. What does that do exactly? Well, it prevents your holding stations from getting too hot- and once its destroyed, your holding station food's freshness levels will decrease 90% faster than they normally would for the entire day! 

It is an insane attack that will destroy most players, since holding station foods will only last seconds. Good luck!

In addition to the 35+ levels there will be achievements and two extra trinkets, and the next update will feature a much larger trinket update! With the extra time I've had between this update and Newer Orleans I've also fixed a number of bugs that have needed to be addressed for a while, such as the Halo-Halo impossible recipe, the Creme Brulee torch bug that would "freeze" the brulee, decreased Well Done cooking times for meats by 50%, and more! 

Thanks y'all and look for the update early next week!

notes.title: Newer Orleans Update Preview!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/0f02807994798f998df20a4ae755cca578d9c304.png[/img]

This is by far not only the biggest update we've done for CSD 3 up to this point, but maybe the biggest update I've ever done in my whole career makin' games! How crazy is that? Let's dig into all the new goodies that you'll be getting next week!


[b]Welcome to Newer Orleans[/b]

The newest territory, Newer Orleans, is a wasteland in dire need of hope. Perhaps you can shine a light with your delicious food, Chef. Just watch out for the new Esteban's food truck- their new nasty hack attack can blind you to important UI elements, and makes prepping food even harder than usual. 

While the general guidelines for this area recommend a full Level 20 or above hazmat suit for outside use, you'll find most citizens just want to continue living and dressing as they did before. Is it a desperate yearning for life before the bombs, or ignorance, or carelessness that they don't all suit up? All I know is that guy wants a King Cake, and he's gonna get one, by golly. 

Enjoy over 30 levels with some of the hardest stops yet! Good luck Chef!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/f45ca297ad298fce2eeead7d83875e125b097953.png[/img]

[b]Steam Trading Cards & Achievements[/b]

Along with new challenging achievements we will also be releasing Steam trading cards! Collect all eight and earn delicious Gelato badges, emoticons and backgrounds. 


[b]Additional Dialogue from Whisk and Cleaver[/b]

All new end-day dialogue lines from [url=https://twitter.com/negaoryx]@negaoryx[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/HavanaRama]@havanarama[/url] have been added to the game! You can get a taste of it [url=https://twitter.com/chubigans/status/1247565939035582464?s=20]here[/url]. These were all improv'd by Havana and negaoryx and it was a lot of fun to record at the end of a very long VO session, and I'm so happy we're getting them into the game. They will pop up sporadically during the course of the game and will not be included as a "repeat" line, so they'll be a bit more rare. 


[b]Customize your Food Truck[/b]

Finally, the biggest update yet- the ability to customize your food truck! We have 40 trinkets available for this update, with dozens more to come in future updates. You'll be able to place statues and posters all over your truck, some earned, some you can buy, and a few that are challenges you must complete. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/3436ea7e739d4fd41c2b6fa80ba4cde089ae7837.png[/img]

In CSD 2 the editor was, to put it mildly, not the best in terms of user interaction. We wanted to make sure we got it right this time, and I think you'll find it to be a much better overall experience. That said we're definitely looking for feedback on any improvements that you might like in the editor, so be sure to check it out!


[b]...And More![/b]

There's still plenty more to the update, including new food descriptions, some balancing changes, and, well, more! I can't wait for y'all to dig in next week. 

Thanks once again for all the positive support y'all gave when we announced the delay of this update from March, and I hope you feel that the wait was worth it! And thank you for all the positive reviews- we're so close to 500 reviews, a huge milestone, all thanks to y'all! 

Thanks again, stay safe out there, and cya soon with the update!

notes.title: Update v0.75 Coming Early April
notes.notes:
Hey y'all! As you've seen so far we've been doing well in sticking to our original Early Access roadmap. While the schedule I initially revealed was a bit of a tight one, I was confident that I'd be able to hit all the targets, barring any kind of catastrophe. 

Well, I uh don't think I need to tell you that something just like that happened. 

Unfortunately this means I have to push back our next update to early April instead of the end of this month. It's been crazy trying to reorganize our schedules and refocus on making games, but I'm finally in a good place to where I can start makin' levels and improvements again. 

While this will also push back our original May estimate of finishing the game back to June, this will also give me a chance to work on other components of the game. The original tight schedule didn't allow for me to really dig into the meat of the game to make engine improvements, and with this delay I'm going to do just that! This includes:

[list]
[*]More great voice work by [url=https://twitter.com/negaoryx]negaoryx[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/HavanaRama]Havana Mahoney[/url]! There are a number of great improv lines that I can't wait to add to the game.
[*]Ability to remap the right stick for auto-serve so that the gamepad functions more like CSD 2.
[*]The ability to customize your truck to be much larger in scope than planned. Originally I just wanted around a dozen or two dozen trinkets and only have the ability to turn them on or off. Now there will be trinket updates once a month with a much more comprehensive editor that allows you to fine tune how you want your trinkets to be displayed! 
[*]Better subtitle support for cutscenes.
[*]And lots more!
[/list]

You can expect v0.75 to include a brand new territory and the Trinkets editor as well as a few of the above improvements in early April!

Thanks everyone and I deeply apologize for the delay. I hope all of you are safe and doing well in these crazy times, and I'll be back next week with a preview of all the fun goodies we have in store. Take care,

-David

notes.title: Grandview County Update Preview!
notes.notes:
One of the best things about Early Access for me as a developer is being able to watch the journey of players as they tackle new challenges. What is working, what's not, what provides a fun challenge, what's frustrating? And certainly watching players gives me all new ideas on how to challenge y'all further.

Enter Grandview County, the biggest update so far with 40 levels and tons of new features! Here's just a sample of what you'll be seeing in this update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/ca01d0e348b4b6ba04bf9cd70ae4666a4e1a32fb.png[/img]

[b]VIP CUSTOMERS[/b]

These snobby influencers don't play by the rules, and only order Special Order foods during a stop! This can change the dynamics of a day quite dramatically, so be sure to plan your Special Order menu accordingly!

[b]FIREKICKERS FOOD TRUCK SIGHTED[/b] 

One of the most brutal attacks in the game, Firekickers will ram your truck in such a way that will destroy every single food you have in all of your holding stations- and will wait until the last minute before a stop to do so. Yikes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/3f373f9c8c636f595b43fe64be54f873ac3e0bbf.png[/img]

[b]RANDOM FOODS[/b]

Back by popular demand, Random Foods will choose from the list of available foods in a day and the foods you have currently bought and serve up a unique challenge each time! There are even special days that require all foods to be random. Good luck Chef!


As always more achievements will be added and some feature requests will also be in, such as toggling upgrades on and off. Look for it this Friday at 11am Central! Thanks as always for all the support!

notes.title: Update Preview: Love County Brings 39 New Levels for Valentine's Day!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Love County! Here in Marietta, Oklahoma things have taken a turn for the worse, and the entire area has been uprooted by the large Texas Border Wall. Now the entire city is under police and military control, which has lead to many food trucks shying away from the area...and a volatile customer base!

The routes in this city are incredibly short, meaning you'll be more focused on Special Orders than ever before. Upgrading your food truck to carry over as much food to the next stop as possible is absolutely key here. Good luck Chef!

Along with these 39 new levels comes new achievements and new features, additional story sequences and improvements! I'm also introducing two new gameplay modifiers that will further change the dynamics of the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35579056/f506946d38b79bd80c0a094aea4a291f8914d584.png[/img]

[b]IMPATIENT CUSTOMERS:[/b] These customers don't have time to waste, and tend to leave much faster than normal customers. They walk in with the "yellow" patience attribute, which means the order will leave the screen a little faster, so make sure your Holding Stations are full of food!

[b]CRAZY CUSTOMERS:[/b] The effects of war have finally gotten to these customers, and every single one will be extremely impatient as they start with the "red" patience attribute. These levels are very nearly impossible without the right upgrades and are a massive challenge. Good luck with these, you're gonna need it!

Note that neither of these attributes affect Special Orders, just Holding Station orders.

Expect more fun challenges with every new Territory update, and cya this Friday! (update is currently scheduled to hit around 11am CST, be sure to follow [url=https://twitter.com/chubigans]@chubigans[/url] for the latest details and [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/cookservedelicious]join our Discord[/url] for the latest news!)
